checks.command:
uv build --wheel --out-dir "$DSR_QUALITY_RUN_DIR/dist" &&
uv export --locked --no-dev --no-emit-project --no-hashes --output-file "$DSR_QUALITY_RUN_DIR/wheel-runtime.txt" > /dev/null &&
cd "$DSR_QUALITY_RUN_DIR" &&
export UV_TOOL_DIR="$PWD/tools" UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR="$PWD/bin" &&
uv tool install --python 3.13 --constraints "$PWD/wheel-runtime.txt" "$PWD"/dist/*.whl &&
"$UV_TOOL_DIR/model-guided-research/bin/python" -I - <<'PY'
import json
from importlib.metadata import distribution
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
from zipfile import ZipFile

import torch
import nanochat

wheel, = Path("dist").glob("*.whl")
origin = json.loads(distribution("model-guided-research").read_text("direct_url.json"))
assert origin["url"] == wheel.resolve().as_uri(), origin
module = Path(nanochat.__file__)
assert module.is_relative_to(Path(sys.prefix)), module
with ZipFile(wheel) as archive:
    assert module.read_bytes() == archive.read("nanochat/__init__.py")
for name, cls in nanochat.MECHANISM_CLASSES.items():
    model = cls.from_dims(n_embd=32, n_head=4)
    x = torch.randn(2, 8, 32, requires_grad=True)
    output = model(x)
    assert output.shape == x.shape and torch.isfinite(output).all(), name
    output.sum().backward()
    assert x.grad is not None and torch.isfinite(x.grad).all(), name
for registry in ("hypotheses", "theorems"):
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "-m", "cli", registry, "validate"], check=True)
print(f"Installed mechanisms exercised: {len(nanochat.MECHANISM_CLASSES)}")
PY
